record.field: Has management provided a written representation that they have fulfilled their responsibilities for preparing the financial statements in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework, including, where relevant, fair presentation, as specified in the audit engagement?
Has the written representation been presented in the form of a representation letter addressed to the auditor?

Does the written representation state that management has provided all relevant information and access as agreed in the terms of the audit engagement, and that all transactions have been recorded and reflected in the financial statements?
Have management's responsibilities been described in the written representation in accordance with the responsibilities set out in the terms of the audit engagement?
Is the date of the written representation the same as the date of the auditor’s report on the financial statements?
Does the written representation cover the entire financial statements and the period(s) referred to in the auditor’s report?
Is it ensured that the auditor’s opinion is not expressed and the auditor’s report is not dated before the date of the written representation?

If relevant, are there one or more specific assertions in the financial statements for which the auditor should request additional representations to support other audit evidence relevant to the financial statements in accordance with other relevant auditing standards?
